capabilities: Auto-link known rule terms to their definitions at render time
Maintain a read-only ds-glossary.md note as a stable link target
Support user-defined terms and aliases via settings
Skip code blocks, existing links, headings, and other non-prose content
disambiguation: Links are rendered at view time only; note text is never edited.
extras: Full details are deferred to a DOCUMENTATION.md file rather than the README; installation is recommended through the BRAT beta-plugin installer.
problem: Draw Steel rule terms mentioned in notes stay as plain text, so readers have to look up definitions manually instead of hovering a link.

relations.evidence: built with the intent of being used alongside it, with the rule Compendium installed through its settings

summary: Auto-links Draw Steel rule terms in notes to a glossary note or Compendium entry, with hover-preview definitions.
